Tradition Realty Group

Real estate, with a neighbor's point of view.

Tradition Realty Group is Dillon Loren's real estate business, started in 2016. It is where the neighborhood knowledge on Tradition Local meets the work of helping someone move.

Tradition Local first. Real estate when you are ready.

Tradition Local is where we get to know Houston together: honest reviews, neighborhood guides, and things to do. There is no sales pitch in any of it.

Tradition Realty Group is for the day you decide to move, rent, buy, or sell. By then you already know the neighborhoods, so the conversation starts a few steps ahead.
